what_happened.line: The task force took no votes other than adjourning; the meeting was informational.
Members heard that the asset management grant contract with CEI is still being finalized with the state, with work expected next year.
CEI's contract includes exploring a stormwater enterprise fund; funds are encumbered and the town manager authorized work to continue.
The DPW stormwater lead was asked to track staff hours on stormwater tasks and share initial data at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: A stormwater enterprise fund would change how stormwater work is paid for, from general taxes to fees on property owners, so the study and the DPW time tracking are early groundwork for a bill residents could later be asked to pay.
Nothing was decided, so the fee question is still at the information-gathering stage and no fee has been proposed.
